Privacy

Short version: what you type into the tool stays in your browser.

● Last updated November 15, 2026

What stays in your browser

The investments and amounts you enter are worked out on your device. They are not uploaded, and there is no account or server that could receive them. The tool keeps your latest mix in this tab only (session storage) so a lesson can use it; closing the tab clears it.

What the sign-up form sends

Only if you submit the sign-up form: your email address, your role (investor, student, instructor or other), your school if you give one, the plan you are interested in, and that you consented. It goes to Formspree, the form service that receives our sign-ups, and nowhere else. No portfolio data ever leaves your browser, and none is attached. We use it to email you about early access.

The form loads no script from Formspree or anyone else: your browser posts those five answers directly when you press “Join the list”. Formspree keeps them under its own privacy policy.

You can ask us to delete your entry at any time by replying to any email we send you.

No analytics, no cookies

The site sets no cookies and runs no analytics or trackers. It loads no third-party scripts, fonts or images. Price and rate data are files served from the same site. GitHub Pages, which hosts the site, keeps its own server logs under its own policy.

Payments

Nothing is sold yet. When payments open, they will happen on the payment provider’s own page; card details never touch this site.

Information, not investment advice.
